title_vi: Nhiều nhất một lần, ít nhất một lần, đúng một lần: quyết định nằm ở chỗ lưu vị trí

claims.evidence: The Message Delivery Semantics section of the Kafka design page was read from a partial clone of apache/kafka; the four consumer orderings were measured by the author, who ran them on Kafka 4.4.0 (three brokers on one machine) with PostgreSQL 16.15 and confluent-kafka 2.16.0 on 2026-10-18.

Not GitHub, not a real phone and not learner testing.

claims.claim_vi: Kafka defines at most once, at least once and exactly once; the problem splits into the durability of publishing and the guarantees of consuming; since 0.11.0.0 the producer has an idempotent option (producer ID plus sequence numbers) and transactions across partitions.
claims.verified_by: Read from a partial clone of apache/kafka at commit 65566690ca1ddb584388c1026e2ff6673e9c6f19.

claims.claim_vi: A consumer that saves its position before processing gives at-most-once on failure; one that processes before saving gives at-least-once; for external systems the simpler alternative to two-phase commit is storing the offset in the same place as the output; exactly-once within Kafka uses the transactional producer and read_committed consumers, other destinations need their cooperation; Kafka guarantees at-least-once by default; many systems' exactly-once claims do not hold under failures.
claims.verified_by: Read from a partial clone of apache/kafka at commit 65566690ca1ddb584388c1026e2ff6673e9c6f19.

claims.claim_vi: Measured with 10 payments and a consumer that stops at payment 6, then a second run in the same group: commit-then-process left 9 ledger rows (payment 6 missing); process-then-commit left 11 rows (payment 6 twice); process with a not-exists check left 10; writing the ledger row and the next offset in one PostgreSQL transaction and seeking to the stored offset left 10.
claims.verified_by: The author ran and measured this on 2026-10-18; auto-commit was off and the stop happened without saving anything further.

claims.claim_vi: At-most once suits monitoring metrics; at-least once suits cases where duplicates are acceptable or can be removed with a unique key; exactly once is hardest and suits financial use cases when duplicates are unacceptable and downstream lacks idempotency.

design_notes_vi: Hai thứ tự lưu vị trí và hai cách được kết quả đúng một lần, mỗi thẻ ghi số dòng của sổ sau thử nghiệm; ba lời khuyên chọn theo dữ liệu. Không dùng ảnh nguồn.
source_deviations: The source attaches each semantic to a class of applications; the lesson shows the mechanism (the order of saving the position and processing) and measures all four variants.
The lesson adds Kafka's idempotent producer and the limit that exactly-once to external systems needs the application's cooperation.
